title: bug: create_task and record_commit's normal branch record no actor, so get_activity_log by workerId misses every row a seat files and every commit its wrapper records (record_commit's own owner-guard branch passes it)
description:
Filed by defect hunt 11-03 #3 (task-859eff80). The three actor rows d981e0b0, 2e3012b9 and e977c32b closed every other task path. These two are the remainder: mem:gotcha-task-event-actor-inventory lists neither as fixed nor as deliberately actor-less.

PROBLEM
- state/taskStore.ts:361 writes TASK_CREATED as `appendActivity('TASK_CREATED', { title: task.title }, task)`, with no actorWorkerId. create_task receives the caller's workerId (tools/createTask.ts:42, :135-137), but uses it only to resolve the createdBy ROLE. state.createTask(input) (StateManager.ts:667 -> taskStore.ts:289) has no actor parameter. createdBy is a role enum, so nothing durable records WHICH seat filed a row.
- tools/recordCommit.ts:379 calls `state.updateTask(task.id, updates, 'TASK_COMMIT_RECORDED')` without the 4th (actor) argument. Its sibling branch at :364-370, the owner-guard refusal audit row, does pass params.workerId as the actor. The tool already records the caller as recordedBy (:296).
- Consequence: get_activity_log { workerId } filters on the top-level workerId only (getActivityLog.ts:131-132). So it returns none of a seat's task creations and none of the commits its wrapper recorded.

EVIDENCE
1. Live log .moe/activity.log, 2026-11-03 09:13Z-16:12Z: all 21 TASK_CREATED and all 87 TASK_COMMIT_RECORDED events have no workerId. The daemon is edc27e14, and both lines are unchanged at ef5c7101.
2. Repro on HEAD ef5c7101 in /tmp/hunt-859e-snap (git archive with Linux node_modules). Persisted copies: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-859e/zzHunt859eActor.test.ts and actor.output.txt. Command: `cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/zzHunt859eActor.test.ts`. Result: 2 failed, 1 passed.
   - create_task {workerId:'governor-g1'}: the TASK_CREATED actors give `expected [ null ] to deeply equal [ 'governor-g1' ]`, and get_activity_log {workerId:'governor-g1'} gives `expected [] to include 'TASK_CREATED'`.
   - record_commit, outcome committed, {workerId:'worker-1'}: `expected [ null ] to deeply equal [ 'worker-1' ]`; the per-seat query gives `expected [] to include 'TASK_COMMIT_RECORDED'`.
   - Control: record_commit, outcome refused, code MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_ACTIVE_ASSIGNEE, records actors ['worker-1'] and passes at HEAD.

FIX DIRECTION
Thread a bare params.workerId through as the actor, the way the earlier rows did:
- add an optional actorWorkerId parameter to taskStore.createTask and to the StateManager.createTask wrapper, and pass it from tools/createTask.ts. The board's caller (server/WebSocketServer.ts:451) stays actor-less;
- pass the 4th updateTask argument at recordCommit.ts:379.
Never record a placeholder: a caller-less call records no workerId, not 'unknown' and not recordedBy's UNIDENTIFIED_RELEASER. No response or contract change.

FILES: packages/moe-daemon/src/state/taskStore.ts, state/StateManager.ts, tools/createTask.ts, tools/recordCommit.ts, plus one NEW test file under packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/. Test pattern: mem:gotcha-task-event-actor-inventory. None is held by an open row (lanes.js at 16:21Z).
definitionOfDone: create_task with a workerId writes TASK_CREATED with that seat as its top-level workerId, and get_activity_log { workerId } returns it. A create_task without a workerId, and the board's /ws create, record no workerId.

record_commit's normal (non-owner-guard) branch writes TASK_COMMIT_RECORDED with the caller as its top-level workerId, as its owner-guard branch already does. A caller-less call records no workerId, never 'unknown'.

A NEW test file under packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/ covers both tools, including the caller-less rows. Restoring either call site fails it, and the existing createTask.test.ts and recordCommit.test.ts pass unchanged.

Verification, in a snapshot outside the shared checkout: `cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/<new test file> src/tools/createTask.test.ts src/tools/recordCommit.test.ts && npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0.

No worker records are needed: resolveWorkerRole (util/workerRole.ts) falls back to the governor- id prefix, and record_commit's touchWorker no-ops for an unknown seat.

implementationPlan.description:
The fix: thread the caller's bare workerId through as the event actor, with the Edit tool (global rail 3). Match /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-c05b/fix.diff (+8/-6) text for text, so that mutants.sh's anchors apply; match on the call text, not line numbers, in case a peer lands first.
(1) state/taskStore.ts:289: `export async function createTask(state: StateManager, input: Partial<Task>, actorWorkerId?: string): Promise<Task> {`
(2) state/taskStore.ts:361: replace the TASK_CREATED line with fix.diff's two comment lines (the actor is a parameter, never read from `input`, because the board passes its raw /ws payload as `input`) followed by `state.appendActivity('TASK_CREATED', { title: task.title }, task, undefined, undefined, undefined, actorWorkerId);`. appendActivity's 7th parameter (state/activityLog.ts:37) is the actor channel updateTask already uses.
(3) state/StateManager.ts:667-668: `async createTask(input: Partial<Task>, actorWorkerId?: string): Promise<Task> {` and `return createTask(this, input, actorWorkerId);`.
(4) tools/createTask.ts:169: the closing `});` of the `state.createTask({ ... })` call becomes `}, params.workerId);`.
(5) tools/recordCommit.ts:379: `updated = await state.updateTask(task.id, updates, 'TASK_COMMIT_RECORDED', params.workerId);`, the value the owner-guard branch (:364-370) already passes.

Rules: pass params.workerId BARE. Never recordedBy (it falls back to UNIDENTIFIED_RELEASER 'unknown', recordCommit.ts:296), never resolvedCreatedBy/createdBy (a role, not a seat), never `|| 'unknown'`, never task.assignedWorkerId (state/activityLog.ts:74-83: an audit actor is never guessed). Keep the actor a separate parameter and never read it from `input`. Leave server/WebSocketServer.ts:451 byte-identical, so the board create stays actor-less. Leave create_task's cycle-drop updateTask (:190, `{ dependsOn: kept }`) alone: its comment says it cannot fire today, and it is outside the DoD. No response, inputSchema, tool description or docs change (DoD: no contract change).

Error handling: unchanged by design. A failed writeEntity or updateTask still throws out of the tool exactly as before, and appendActivity stays best-effort (backpressure drop, logged append failures). The extra argument adds no failure path and no try/catch.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: create_task records the calling seat (its bare params.workerId) as the TASK_CREATED activity event's top-level workerId, and record_commit's normal (non-owner-guard) branch records it on TASK_COMMIT_RECORDED, as the owner-guard branch already does. get_activity_log { workerId } then returns a seat's task creations and the commits its wrapper recorded. A caller-less create_task or record_commit, and the board's /ws CREATE_TASK, record no workerId: never 'unknown', a role or the assignee. No tool response, input schema or documented contract changes.
acceptanceCriteria: create_task { workerId: W } writes TASK_CREATED whose top-level workerId is W, and get_activity_log { workerId: W } returns it; the response (including createdBy) is unchanged.
A create_task without workerId, and the board's CREATE_TASK over /ws (even with a payload carrying workerId or actorWorkerId), write TASK_CREATED with no workerId.

record_commit's normal branch (committed, nothing, and refused/failed with a code other than the two owner-guard codes) writes TASK_COMMIT_RECORDED with the caller as top-level workerId; a caller-less call records none (commits[].recordedBy keeps its 'unknown' fallback).

The new tools/createCommitActor.test.ts fails when either call site is restored (mutants M1, M2) or the store or wrapper drops the actor (M3, M4), when a placeholder actor is introduced ('unknown' M5, recordedBy M6, the createdBy role M7), and when taskStore reads the actor from input (M8); createTask.test.ts and recordCommit.test.ts pass unchanged.
invariants: An activity actor is never guessed: no assignee, recordedBy, createdBy-role or 'unknown' fallback (state/activityLog.ts:74-83).
The actor is a separate optional parameter of taskStore.createTask and StateManager.createTask, never read from the input object, which on the board path is the raw /ws payload.
record_commit's owner-guard branch, response shape, commits[].recordedBy, lastCommitOutcome, path sets and chat lines are unchanged.
create_task's response, createdBy role attribution, advisory warnings and PLANNING announcements are unchanged.
compatibility: Existing .moe/activity.log lines without workerId stay valid; get_activity_log's filter and response shape are unchanged.
server/WebSocketServer.ts:451 keeps its one-argument state.createTask(payload) call; JetBrains and VS Code CREATE_TASK frames are unchanged.
StateManager.createTask's new parameter is optional, so every existing caller, tests included, compiles unchanged.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) The actor as a field of `input` (e.g. input.actorWorkerId): rejected. The board's CREATE_TASK passes its raw /ws payload as `input`, so a client could name its own actor. A separate parameter keeps the board actor-less by construction; mutant M8 and case z3 pin it. (2) recordedBy as record_commit's actor: rejected, it falls back to UNIDENTIFIED_RELEASER 'unknown' (M6). (3) The createdBy role: rejected, a role is not a seat (M7). (4) Also passing the actor at create_task's cycle-drop updateTask (:190): rejected, its comment says it cannot fire today, so it is untestable and outside the DoD. (5) Normalizing an explicit '' workerId: rejected, it belongs in appendActivity, a shared surface (mem:gotcha-task-event-actor-inventory). (6) Docs or tool-description edits: none. The DoD says no contract change, no doc enumerates per-event actors, and the three earlier actor rows (d981e0b0, 2e3012b9, e977c32b) changed no docs. (7) A state-level board row (state.createTask(payload) with a smuggled field) was prototyped first, then replaced by z3 over a real /ws socket, so DoD 1's board clause is tested literally.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: appendActivity's 7th parameter actorWorkerId (state/activityLog.ts:30-37) becomes the event's top-level workerId (:83, worker?.id || proposal?.workerId || actorWorkerId) and never falls back to the assignee. updateTask's 4th argument feeds it (taskStore.ts:647-649), and get_activity_log filters on that field only (getActivityLog.ts:131-132). StateManager's task API is thin delegation to state/taskStore.ts. The only callers of state.createTask are tools/createTask.ts:157 and server/WebSocketServer.ts:451; benchmarks/baselineRun.ts has an unrelated local createTask. record_commit's touchWorker no-ops for an unregistered seat, and resolveWorkerRole falls back to the id prefix, so the test needs no worker records. The MoeWebSocketServer constructor starts no timers, so a z3-style socket row needs only an HTTP listener on port 0 and closes cleanly.
planningNotes.risks: The fix text must match fix.diff, or mutants.sh reports NOT APPLIED. Never run vitest or npm ci in the shared checkout or the worktree (global rail 1): the checkRef and mutants.sh each run in their own mktemp snapshot and only read the tree. z3 binds 127.0.0.1:0 and closes the socket, WS server and HTTP server in finally; under heavy host load rerun the file once before calling it flaky. Error handling is unchanged: the extra argument adds no failure path. Rail 2 (no pattern-kill) applies to any hung test run.
